The '''Corellian Shipbuilders Union''' operated during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> [[Jadam Questrel]] was the Union's official representative in [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="SWG:AED" /> and the head of the [[Guild of Non-Human Skilled Laborers]], the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Kijo Mnuue]], had some contacts within the union.<ref name="CRO" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a member of the Union was attacked by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops on Corellia because he wandered too close to an Imperial outpost while picking [[Hsuaberry|hsuaberries]]. The worker took shelter in an animal den to lose the pursuit and successfully escaped. The Corellian Shipbuilders Union Local 44908 later realized that the den would make a nice base for berry-picking activities and recruited a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to drive out the animals.<ref name="SWG:LSFBP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Lair Suitable For Berry-Picking}} on Corellia</ref>
